text_run.content: This operation adds a new scalar field to an existing collection without recreating it. The field becomes available almost immediately with minimal delay due to internal schema synchronization.

If the collection has the dynamic field enabled and you add a static field with the same name as an existing dynamic field key, the static field will mask the dynamic field key. The original dynamic values remain accessible via the

milvusClient.addCollectionField({
    collection_name: string,
    db_name?: string,
    field: FieldType,
    timeout?: number
